label: Edit
depicts: Square corner frame with a diagonal pencil stroke crossing upward to the right
use_when: Use when the interface wants editing shown inside a square compose frame rather than a loose pencil.
avoid_when: Do not use for standalone pencil icons when the visible square frame matters.

label: Edit
depicts: Tilted pencil shape with a capped body and pointed tip line
use_when: Use when the interface needs the simplest standalone pencil symbol for editing or writing.
avoid_when: Do not use for framed or baseline edit variants when the loose pencil silhouette is the cue.

label: AI Writing Assist
depicts: Tilted pencil shape with two spark stars around the body
use_when: Use when the interface wants to show editing enhanced by an added spark or AI cue.
avoid_when: Do not use for the plain pencil when the surrounding spark stars need to be visible.

label: Edit
depicts: Tilted pencil shape with a short horizontal base line below the tip
use_when: Use when the interface wants editing shown as writing along a short baseline.
avoid_when: Do not use for the loose pencil when the baseline under the tip is the visible differentiator.

label: AI Writing Assist
depicts: Tilted pencil shape on a base line with one spark star above
use_when: Use when the interface wants a writing line icon that also carries a small spark enhancement cue.
avoid_when: Do not use for the plain baseline pencil when the added spark star is part of the intended meaning.
